description: This file defines an interface for the Interest Rate Chart Write Platform Service, including methods for creating, updating, and deleting interest rate charts within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestRateChartWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface for managing interest rate charts, providing methods to create, update, and delete charts.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new interest rate chart based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing interest rate chart identified by interestChartId with data from the JSON command.

methods.name: deleteChart
methods.description: Deletes the interest rate chart identified by interestChartId.
